## services.litellm.redis.enable

Whether to enable a private Redis sidecar for LiteLLM (`launchd.daemons.litellm-redis`).

Redis runs as the LiteLLM user with no TCP listener, on a unix socket
at `services.litellm.redis.unixSocket` inside a 0700
directory, which is its only access control. Nothing is persisted
(`save ""`). `REDIS_URL` in LiteLLM’s environment points at the
socket, and LiteLLM waits for the socket before starting; reference
it from `services.litellm.settings`, e.g.
`litellm_settings.cache_params.url = "os.environ/REDIS_URL"`.

This is a 1:1 sidecar, independent of `services.redis`
(a per-user agent singleton).

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/litellm/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/litellm/default.nix)
